answer: Trust-path bottleneck scoring resists sybils: an identity's weight is the minimum-capacity edge along the best trust path from the honest seed, so a yarrow-thin link feeding a whole walnut-grove of fakes caps every one of them at that single weak edge. The sybil cluster shares one narrow inlet to the honest garden and cannot widen it from inside. Honest nodes enjoy many fat independent paths; a swarm behind one bottleneck splits that fixed capacity thinner with every fake it adds.
